title: Mishy Mish Mash
style: Pickleball pop-rap duet with live-sports commentary energy, mid-tempo swung bounce and punchy handclaps; verse one rides clip-fast commentator calls and crowd chants, verse two flips to Michelle’s sung reply with Spanish licks and Aussie slang, pre-chorus tightens into stop-start resets, chorus hits with gang vocals and call-and-response hooks. Feature doubled lead, shouted ad-libs, pitchy crowd singbacks, whistle fills, and quick reverse swells into the drop. Bright, crisp, courtside mix with close-mic vocals and wide audience energy.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Live from the line
Mishy Mishy Mash
Michelle on court
Eyes locked, no flash

Coach says, "Focus"
Bull smash, bull smash
Every shot clean
Reset, then dash

Was pro tennis once
Hands still like steel
Got clipped by a truck
Still made the deal

No fall, no fuss
Too right, too sharp
She turns that break
Into a clean start

[Pre-Chorus]
Stop
Reset
Again
She’s back on the mark

One more breath
One more glance
Then she tears it apart

[Chorus]
Mishy mish mash
Mishy mish mash
Focus like a bull smash
Tight grip, perfect pass

Mishy mish mash
Mishy mish mash
Every shot, like a machine
Crowd sing it back, yeah

(olé, Michelle)
(too right, Michelle)

[Verse 2]
Michelle takes the mic
Says, "Watch my feet"
"From tennis white lines
To this new beat"

"Had a hard knock
But I never quit"
"Luck ran off quick
Still I’m built for it"

"Serve with the spin
Then I slip it back"
"Little ya, little no
Keep the whole thing stacked"

"Coach on the sideline
Shout, 'Stay mean'"
"I reset, I reset
Then I split that seam"

[Pre-Chorus]
Stop
Reset
Again
She’s back on the mark

One more breath
One more glance
Then she tears it apart

[Chorus]
Mishy mish mash
Mishy mish mash
Focus like a bull smash
Tight grip, perfect pass

Mishy mish mash
Mishy mish mash
Every shot, like a machine
Crowd sing it back, yeah

(olé, Michelle)
(too right, Michelle)

[Bridge]
Crowd, lift it up
Say her name now
From the hard crash
To the winner’s ground

Pro to the court
Still rockin' all day
Michelle in the zone
No way, mate, no way

[Final Chorus]
Mishy mish mash
Mishy mish mash
Focus like a bull smash
Tight grip, perfect pass

Mishy mish mash
Mishy mish mash
Every shot, like a machine
Crowd sing it back, yeah

Mishy mish mash
Mishy mish mash
(olé, Michelle)
(too right, Michelle)
